title: Contra 80s (Mesen HD pack)

licence.summary: Free Mesen HD pack (README: "a free Mesen HD Pack developed by Tastic"); no licence file
licence.redistribution: Downloaded from the author's own link only when you choose this pack; NeoStation does not host or redistribute the files.

requirements: hires.txt format 106, scale 2 (512x480). Made for Contra (USA), the ROM its <supportedRom> line names. Mesen decodes its images when the game starts: about 1.6 GB of memory, so devices that cannot give it that much refuse the pack.
notes: Mesen HD pack (hires.txt), installed in System › HdPacks in the folder named after the game's ROM file. Read by the Mesen engine only: switching it on makes the game start with Mesen (Nestopia reads no HD pack). New stage backgrounds, sprites and title cards inspired by 1980s films (README).

title: Megaman: Super (16-bit Mesen graphics pack)

licence.summary: No licence stated; README: fan work with no original Capcom assets, only remixed fan-made graphics
licence.redistribution: Downloaded from the author's own link only when you choose this pack; NeoStation does not host or redistribute the files.

requirements: hires.txt format 106, scale 1 (redrawn 16-bit style tiles at the original size). Its patch (Megaman - Super.ips) applies only to the two Mega Man ROMs whose SHA-1 hires.txt names; README: if the patch does not apply, the ROM differs.
notes: Mesen HD pack (hires.txt), installed in System › HdPacks in the folder named after the game's ROM file. Read by the Mesen engine only: switching it on makes the game start with Mesen (Nestopia reads no HD pack). The default pack only; the Customization folder (music and pause variants) is not installed.
